📖 How to use

      
  1. Paste your page URLs into the box, one per line.
  2. Choose a change frequency, priority and whether to add trailing slashes.
  3. Click Generate Sitemap to validate every URL and build the XML.
  4. Copy the XML or download sitemap.xml and upload it to your site root.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is a sitemap.xml?
An XML file listing your site's pages so search engines can discover and crawl them efficiently.
Where do I upload it?
Upload sitemap.xml to your website's root folder (e.g. example.com/sitemap.xml) and submit it in Google Search Console.
How many URLs can it contain?
The sitemap protocol allows up to 50,000 URLs and 50 MB per file. For larger sites, split them into multiple sitemaps.
